counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.019705984023247552 to 0.001 with all else identical; finer timestep resolves the close pericenter passage and energy stays conserved

explanation: Two massive bodies undergo a close encounter (distance ~0.87 at step 13 -> 0.72 at step 14 -> 0.65 at step 15) with high speeds ~8. Substeps per step only rise to 11-12, insufficient to resolve the steeply rising softened gravity, so leapfrog integration loses energy progressively (179.06 at step 13, 173.15 at step 14, 160.93 at step 15). Reducing dt to 0.001 with identical initial conditions removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
vision_note: Two small bodies in the lower-left corner move progressively closer from step 12 to step 15 until they are nearly touching. Their short velocity trails indicate fast motion during this tight close approach.
